jobs.description:
Become a Warehouse Employee at Zara in Almere! Work 3–8 hours per week in the city center, from 7:00 to 10:00/11:00. Perfect alongside another job or studies. Earn €14.99 per hour and be part of an enthusiastic team.

As a warehouse employee at Zara in the center of Almere, you support the store’s logistics. You work 3–8 hours per week, divided over Monday and Thursday mornings, from 7:00 to 10:00/11:00. You ensure that all products are stored neatly and on time in the warehouse. You work with a friendly team and take responsibility for your own tasks.

During your morning shift, you help unpack deliveries. You sort clothing and accessories and place them in the correct location in the warehouse. You make sure the store always has enough stock. After your shift, you help keep the warehouse tidy. You stay active and collaborate with your colleagues.

This job is perfect if you want flexible work alongside your studies or another job. No experience is required. Apply quickly and make a difference in the center of Almere! ✨

You will work for an international retailer in the fashion industry. The working atmosphere is open, energetic, and focused on teamwork. The team is diverse, and everyone is valued. The company is large and offers opportunities for growth. Its mission is to make fashion accessible to everyone. Here, you can be yourself and learn from colleagues.

Requirements

- At least a VMBO-level (secondary education) working and thinking level
- Experience is not required, but is a plus
- Able to work independently and in a team
- Physically fit and proactive
- You speak Dutch or English

Over de jobYou will be working at a leading warehouse that specializes in flooring products such as PVC, laminate, parquet, vinyl, and carpet. The warehouse is part of a family business with over 80 years of experience and focuses on efficiently collecting, packaging, and shipping products to optimally serve customers.
  Your Responsibilities:
       - Collecting orders, using a forklift, reach truck, or electric pallet truck
     - Performing tasks on the cutting machine (cutting rolls)
     - Loading trucks, trailers, and/or delivery vans
     - Inspecting goods from incoming containers and storing them correctly
     - Preparing and shipping orders
     - Ensuring a safe working environment
 
 Wat verwachten wij?     You have experience in logistics
     You are physically fit
     You are willing to work evening shifts
     In possession of a forklift or reach truck certificate (required)
     You speak good Polish and English
     You speak basic Dutch (preferred)
     You have a B driving license
 
 Wat bieden wij jouGood salary:
       - Gross per hour: € 15,40
     - Net per week: € 440,00
 
  The net weekly salary is after deduction of housing and health insurance costs. 
  Plus extras:
       - Weekly vacation pay: 8.33% of your gross salary
     - Pension accrual: starting from your first working day
     - Collective health insurance and assistance with applying for healthcare allowance
 
  Housing and transport
       - Comfortable and safe housing (SNF certified)
     - Free transport to your work or a travel expense reimbursement
 
  Personal guidance
       - An own job coach as a point of contact during your work period
 
  Why choose Interwel?
       - Always on time with your salary (weekly) according to the applicable collective labor agreement
     - Reliable and certified employment agency

For Arvato in Heijen, we are looking for warehouse employees! You make sure that orders are carefully collected, packed, and shipped. If you perform well, there is a chance of being taken over by the company. Read on quickly!

As a warehouse employee, you make sure that orders are processed neatly and on time. You work at the picking line and are responsible for collecting, scanning, checking, and preparing products for shipment.

What's in it for you

    - Gross salary of €14.99 per hour
    
- Temporary contract through Manpower with the possibility of a permanent contract if you perform well
    
- Travel allowance according to the employer’s scheme
    
- Opportunity to work 32 to 40 hours per week
    
- Shift allowance and overtime pay for shift work, overtime, or changed shifts
    
- Working in a modern, digital, and automated logistics environment

    - You work accurately, can count well, and make few mistakes
    
- You have a valid Dutch work permit
    
- You can work independently and also work well in a team
    
- Experience with a scanner is a plus and you are flexible with working hours and overtime
    
- You are physically fit and speak good English

Apply today through Manpower and we will contact you as soon as possible to discuss the possibilities at Arvato. You might be starting soon! 🚀

Over de jobWe are a leading metal processing organization specializing in the production of high-quality components, with a focus on precision and customer satisfaction.
  
 Your responsibilities:
       - You execute production orders as effectively and efficiently as possible
     - You operate 3-axis CNC and Victor milling machines, making adjustments and performing reconfigurations
     - You produce both small and large series
     - You resolve bottlenecks and problems, either independently or in consultation
     - You work on multiple challenging projects simultaneously in this role
 
 Wat verwachten wij?     - You have experience as a CNC milling machine operator with Fanuc control
     - In possession of a valid driver's license B
     - communicatief English
 
 Wat bieden wij jouGood salary:
       - Per week: € 530,00
     - Per hour: € 15,74
 
  The net weekly salary is after deduction of housing and health insurance costs. You work in 2 shifts.
  Plus extras:
       - Weekly holiday pay: 8.33% of your gross salary
     - Pension accrual: from your first working day
     - Collective health insurance and assistance with applying for health benefits
 
  Housing and transportation
       - Comfortable and safe housing
     - Free transportation to your work or travel expense reimbursement
 
  Personal guidance
       - Your own job coach to assist you during your work period
 
  Why choose Interwel?
       - Always receive your salary on time (weekly) according to the collective labor agreement
     - Reliable and certified employment agency
 
  Do you want to work in the Netherlands with good conditions and guidance? Then you are at the right place with Interwel.

What will you do?As an order picker, you ensure that orders are collected quickly and accurately. Using a hand scanner and tablet, you locate the correct products and transport them using an electric pallet truck (EPT). Once you’ve mastered the job, you’ll have the opportunity to obtain your reach truck certificate and possibly grow into an all-round warehouse employee.
Your responsibilities include:
- Picking orders using a hand scanner and tablet

- Driving an EPT (electric pallet truck)

- Checking and preparing orders for shipment

Who are you?- You have at least 1 year of experience as an order picker or warehouse employee

- You speak Dutch and/or English

- You have an EPT certificate — don’t have one yet? No problem! You can obtain it through Met Louie

- You are willing to work shifts (06:00–15:00 and 10:00–19:00)

Where will you work?You will join a leading company in the import, production, and distribution of authentic Asian food products. From modern production facilities and distribution centers, thousands of hospitality businesses and supermarkets across Europe are supplied daily. With a strong focus on quality, innovation, and service, the company strives to make Asian cuisine accessible to everyone.

What we offer you:- A monthly salary between €2,500 and €2,800 gross

- A modern workplace in Haps, equipped with excellent facilities

- 25 vacation days per year (based on full-time employment)

- Pension plan according to the applicable collective agreement

- A direct contract with the employer

- Travel allowance, development opportunities, and… Friday fries day!

As a woodworker, you will be working at a modern and stable high-tech company in Eindhoven. You will be responsible on a daily basis for dismantling and reassembling wooden transport crates for large and fragile high-tech components. You will do this based on technical drawings and fixed work instructions.

You will check the quality of the work, identify deviations, and work according to applicable safety regulations. The position is carried out in a two-shift system (06:00–15:00 and 15:00–00:00) and offers full-time employment with the prospect of a permanent contract.

- Technical insight and experience with woodworking (e.g. machine or manual woodworking, assembly, or production).
- VMBO level of working and thinking.
- Experience in reading technical drawings.
- Ability to work accurately with a strong focus on quality.
- Willingness to work in a two-shift system (06:00–15:00 and 15:00–00:00).
- Good command of the English language.
- Team player and living in the Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven, Veghel, or Valkenswaard area.

SamenvattingStep into a dynamic role as a Production Operator A and be at the heart of our production, where your skills keep everything running smoothly and contribute directly to delivering fresh, high-quality products every day. Good work!Over de functieThe Operator A is responsible for ensuring that the assigned production line operates efficiently, producing products that meet both quality and quantity standards. This role involves performing basic production tasks while strictly adhering to safety and quality regulations.
Your key Responsibilities:
- Set up and monitor machines and automated processes
- Track production, manage orders, and make adjustments
- Perform quality checks, including metal detection, and report issues
- Maintain order and safety on the line
- Guide and supervise line staff to ensure compliance
- Escalate any deviations

Working hours:
- Our warehouses operate 24/7, so the work schedule includes weekend shifts as well as morning, afternoon, and night shifts.

Shift start times vary depending on the shift and the team. For example, a morning shift may start at 06:00, 08:00, or 10:00.
Over het bedrijfHessing Greenport began as a small family business in 1968 and has since grown into a European leader in fresh vegetables. Operating in 5 countries, we proudly supply top retailers, wholesalers, and hospitality brands with premium quality produce. With a 33% market share in the Netherlands and partnerships with names like Jumbo and Superunie, we set the standard for freshness and innovation. Join us and be part of a team where every day is about excellence, growth, and making a real impact in the food industry!
Wat wij vragen- MBO level 2 work and thinking skills, with relevant experience in a similar role
- Basic knowledge of production processes, quality standards (HACCP, BRC), and safety regulations
- Ability to operate and monitor machinery, handle production data, and perform quality checks
- Good proficiency in Dutch and/or Engli

We are looking for a reliable and experienced Reach Truck Driver to join our warehouse team in Nijmegen. In this position, you will be responsible for safely operating a reach truck, handling goods within the warehouse, and supporting efficient logistics operations during the evening shift.Over de functie- Operate a reach truck safely and efficiently. 
-  Load, unload, move, and store products within the warehouse. 
-  Pick and prepare orders according to instructions. 
-  Ensure inventory is handled accurately and stored correctly. 
-  Follow all safety procedures and warehouse regulations. 
-  Assist with general warehouse duties when required. 
-  Maintain a clean and organized working environment.

      Voorwaarden- Competitive salary and shift allowances where applicable.
- Stable full-time employment.
- Friendly and supportive work environment.
- Opportunities for professional development and growth.
- Modern warehouse facilities and equipment.

Vereisten- Valid reach truck certificate/license. 
-  Previous experience operating a reach truck in a warehouse environment. 
-  Good understanding of warehouse processes and safety standards. 
-  Ability to work independently and as part of a team. 
-  Reliable, accurate, and motivated attitude.
-  Basic communication skills in English.

Quality comes first. As a Quality Employee at Arvato, you make sure products leave the warehouse only when they meet the highest standards. Earn €14.99 gross per hour, receive a travel allowance, and build up a pension while working in a modern logistics environment. Perform well and you could secure a contract with Arvato. Apply now!

Employment agency Manpower is looking for Quality Employees for Arvato in Lelystad.

As a Quality Employee, you will be responsible for:

    - Checking product components, labels, and barcodes
    
- Performing visual and physical inspections of assembled products
    
- Registering quality checks on the production line
    
- Inspecting pallets before shipment
    
- Assessing packaging quality and pallet stability
    
- Verifying quantities on pallets
    
- Recording inspection results using checklists
    
- Identifying quality deviations and helping maintain high standards
    
- Following safety, cleanliness, and workplace procedures

What's in it for you

    - Gross salary of €14.99 per hour
    
- Travel allowance according to the employer's policy
    
- Pension accrual
    
- Free development opportunities through Manpower Academy (more than 200 online courses)
    
- Temporary employment contract through Manpower with the chance of a permanent contract
    
- Opportunity to work 32 to 40 hours per week
    
- Shift allowance or overtime compensation when applicable
    
- Modern and dynamic logistics working environment

    - Availability to work 32 to 40 hours per week
    
- Good command of the English language due to daily communication and work instructions
    
- Ability to work independently as well as in a team
    
- Experience with a scanner is a plus
    
- Willingness to work in a two-shift schedule
    
- Possession of a Certificate of Conduct (VOG) or willingness to apply for one
    
- Good physical condition due to the active nature of the role
    
- Accurate and quality-focused working style
    
- Flexible attitude and willingness to support other tasks when nee

You are the reliable force that not only ensures safe execution of your work, but also prepares shipments and checks incoming orders. Good work!Over de functieYou have a passion for logistics and know your way around the warehouse effortlessly. Your responsibilities include loading and unloading products onto pallets. Think of products such as snacks, sauces and alcoholic beverages. With an eye for detail you check goods and report any discrepancies. Your responsibilities? Read about them here:
- Moving, storing and delivering goods within the warehouse
- Checking pallets
- Keeping your workplace tidy

Your working days are Monday to Sunday, with two alternating days off each week. This makes for a flexible work week of 5 days. You will work in two shifts, your working hours are:
- From 05:00 am to 2:00 pm

Wat wij vragen- You speak Dutch or English, so you can communicate effectively with your colleagues
- You are in possession of a (valid) reach truck certificate
- You have at least 3 year of experience driving a reach truck in a warehouse
- No valid reach truck certificate? No problem! You are willing to get your

Are you a true go-getter with leadership experience in logistics? Do you know how to motivate a team and ensure that everything runs smoothly on the shop floor? Then we’re looking for you!

As a Warehouse Team Leader, you’ll be the first point of contact for your team. You’ll actively participate on the shop floor, manage your colleagues, and ensure that daily logistics processes are carried out safely, efficiently, and according to schedule.

What will you do?
As a Warehouse Team Leader, you will lead a team of approximately 5 to 15 warehouse employees and temporary workers. Together, you make sure all warehouse activities are completed safely, efficiently, and on time.

Your responsibilities include:

- Coordinating daily inbound, storage, order picking, and outbound activities.
- Leading, coaching, and supporting warehouse employees on the work floor.
- Monitoring productivity, quality, and safety standards.
- Ensuring accurate administrative processing in the Warehouse Management System (WMS).
- Reporting operational issues and supporting continuous process improvements.
- Working closely with the Warehouse Supervisor and Customer Service to achieve daily operational targets.
- Helping to create a safe, clean, and organized working environment.

You are a hands-on leader who enjoys working in a fast-paced warehouse environment and knows how to motivate a team.

You also have:

- An MBO Level 3 qualification, preferably in Logistics.
- At least 2 years of experience in a supervisory role within logistics or manufacturing.
- Experience working in a warehouse environment.
- Good communication skills in English (Dutch is an advantage).
- A proactive attitude and strong organizational skills.
- A focus on safety, quality, and teamwork.
- A valid Certificate of Conduct (VOG). If your VOG is approved, Olympia will reimburse the cost of €41.35. If your VOG is not approved, the cost will be at your own expense.
- You have your own accommodation;

Looking for a hands-on job with car parts from top brands like Audi, BMW and Volkswagen? As a warehouse employee, you’ll process and check orders, store parts with care and keep the warehouse running smoothly. You work from 10:00 to 18:00 in a friendly, close-knit team. Earn €14.99 per hour, plus travel allowance, good pension and more benefits. Ready to grow your career in the automotive world? Apply now! 🚀

Employment agency Manpower is looking for a warehouse worker for a client in Nunspeet.

As a warehouse employee, you will work with a wide range of car parts from top brands such as Audi, BMW and Volkswagen. Think of bumpers, roofs, trunk lids, windshields and mirrors. How cool is it to be surrounded by high-quality parts from the automotive world every day? Many of these parts are surprisingly light, and handy tools are available for the heavier items. This allows you to work efficiently and without heavy loads! Some of your tasks include:

    - Receiving, checking and storing incoming goods
    
- Order picking, packaging and shipping of products
    
- Ensuring an organised and efficient warehouse

What’s in it for you

    - Gross salary of €14.99 per hour
    
- Travel allowance of €0.23 per kilometer
    
- Full-time position of 40 hours per week
    
- Pension accrual via Manpower

Are you the warehouse worker we're looking for? Apply today and Manpower will contact you within two working days!

You are responsible for a safe and efficient process of goods receipt, storage, and shipping. You help supply stores and fulfill online orders.

Your workday includes:

    - Receiving, checking, and storing stock
    
- Picking and packing orders
    
- Loading and unloading trucks
    
- Stock checks and inventories
    
- Operating warehouse equipment (forklift if certified)
    
- Driving the reach truck is not a standard part of your duties, but it may occur if necessary.

What's in it for you

- Travel allowance €0.23 per km

jobs.occupation: Via Viku working at hotel Ramada by Wyndham Badhoevedorp as a Housekeeping manager
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a new challenge? Would you describe yourself as customer-focused, a team player and do you like to work with people? Then you might be the all-round person we’re looking for to become our new housekeeping manager at hotel Ramada by Wyndham Badhoevedorp.

As a manager you will use your unique qualities to guarantee that we live up to the high Viku quality standards. You will manage a team of housekeepers and you will supervise the cleaning activities. In addition you will bear final responsibility for the administration, planning, time tracking and the drawing up of work schedules. You will be the face of the hotel and our headquarters as well as the main contact person.

Profile

We are looking for someone who:

- Lives near Badhoevedorp

- Has leadership qualities

- Is responsive and flexible

- Has a customer-oriented attitude

- Is representative

- Is independent, organised and precise

- Speaks Dutch and English

- Has managerial experience as a manager

- Has cleaning experience

- Is energetic, enthusiastic and motivated

 

Other Information

We offer a salary in accordance with the Cleaning-CLA and a pleasant working atmosphere. The feature is a Full-time employment, salary from € 14,74 - € 16,29 excluding yearly bonus from 5%.

Are you interested? Apply using the button below or send you CV and cover letter to werkenbij@viku.nl. We will then contact you as soon as possible!
